root.name: Benko Gambit Accepted: King Walk Variation
root.moves: 1. d4 Nf6 2. c4 c5 3. d5 b5 4. cxb5 a6 5. bxa6 g6 6. Nc3 Bxa6 7. Nf3 d6 8. e4 Bxf1 9. Kxf1 Bg7 10. g3 O-O 11. Kg2

overview: In the fully accepted Benko, White plays g3, trades the f1 bishop for Black's a6 bishop with Bxf1 Kxf1 and walks the king to g2. Black has given a pawn for pressure on the a- and b-files and the long diagonal with ...Bg7. White sits solid with a pawn up and tries to keep Black's rooks out, while Black builds with ...Qa5/Qb6, ...Nbd7, ...Nb6 and ...Rfb8.

white_ideas.idea: Walk the king to g2, develop Nf3 and Re1, and keep the extra pawn safe
Add Nd2-c4 or Qc2 to block Black's queenside pressure

black_ideas.idea: Put rooks on the a- and b-files and queen on a5 or b6, aiming at the weak queenside
Use the Bg7 and ...Nb6/...Nbd7 to trade the white pieces and regain the pawn in the endgame if possible

typical_structures.structure: White pawns on d5/e4 against Black pawns on c5/d6 with open a- and b-files

character.notes: The king walk leads to quiet, manoeuvring play where Black has long-term compensation rather than immediate tactics: Balanced, though unbalanced in material.

gambit.notes: Black gave the b-pawn on move 4 and White can try to keep it; compensation is long-term.

soundness.notes: Sound; the Benko is a respected, reliable gambit at all levels.

structure.notes: White's asymmetrical centre against open a- and b-files for Black: Semi-open.

approach.notes: Played by strong players, a well-known gambit and a standard choice.

level.notes: Compensation is positional and slow, which takes understanding to play well; Intermediate.

character.reason: A quiet manoeuvring phase after the bishop trade; unbalanced material but no forced sequences.

gambit.reason: Black has sacrificed the b-pawn for long-term pressure.

soundness.reason: The Benko is regarded as a sound gambit.

structure.reason: Asymmetrical centre with the a- and b-files opened for Black.

approach.reason: A mainstream gambit played by strong players.

level.reason: Compensation takes understanding more than memory.

plans.reason: Black pushes on the queenside files with a fianchettoed bishop on g7.
